evals.name: explicit-r-patient-status
evals.prompt: Write an R script to read /home/kevinlee/cdisc/sdtm/ds.xpt to provide patient status in a .md file, and run the R script to create the .md file.
evals.expected_output: disp_analysis.R copied to cwd plus a markdown report with Overview / Status Summary / Reason for Discontinuation / Data Notes and no per-subject listing. 110 completed, 144 discontinued, 52 screen failures.

evals.name: python-completion-vs-dropout
evals.prompt: I've got the study data in /home/kevinlee/cdisc. How many patients actually finished the study versus dropped out, and what were the main reasons people came off? Use python please and save it as markdown so I can paste it into our status deck.
evals.expected_output: disp_analysis.py run against the study dir, markdown report with correct counts and DSDECOD-based reason breakdown, completion rate denominator made explicit.

evals.name: dropout-rate-no-language
evals.prompt: what's the dropout rate in /home/kevinlee/cdisc/sdtm and which reason is most common? i need a markdown summary for the DSMB packet
evals.expected_output: Asks for or sensibly defaults to a language, produces the four-section markdown report, states dropout rate with its denominator (144/254 enrolled = 56.7%), identifies ADVERSE EVENT (92) as leading reason.
